parent.original_K4X_observation: 97.8% Wingless, 95.3% Yggdrasil FourRooms attempted forward moves blocked despite public FrontBlocked=true

design.fitsource: One common authentic MiniGrid public-source stream using K4X original frozen training algorithm: seven of eight source steps use public-map BFS and every eighth source step true uniformly exploratory legal action, exactly 6000 public before/action/after/reward transitions per family, 12000 FIT events total; learned from actual env.step. No training on consumed K4R/K4U/K4X sources. R1 and R2 learn identically on this stream, same original native R1 update params, no native weights shared across independent Wingless/Yggdrasil families.
design.cold_restore: All four native models must authenticate frozen code before FIT, serialize after FIT, and validate prediction and full model state after process restart; no native CHECK/DEV updates.
design.traces: Preserve real full per-step public agent pose, front blocked flag, chosen legal action, actual next public pose, actual reward, real goal success and terminal state on each CHECK and DEV, with full source trace checksum.
design.source_guard: STOP BEFORE CHECK/DEV if any authentic FIT observation missing, illegal action, unequal native FIT updates, nonfinite reward, not all 3 actions in FIT source, or FIT conventional learned-dynamics support missing.
design.research_scope: Source-qualified native affordance behavior is necessary but not sufficient for causal planning or native unfamiliar transfer. This is not a pure ablation of action-history/planning or equal energy costs.

metrics.blocking: For each method per family count (a==2 and FrontBlocked before action) / total actual steps, and conditional blocked among forward actions; compare native R2 to same family R1. Do not count artificially avoiding all action2 as success unless actual goal completion.
metrics.success: 8 heldout DEV worlds per family, fresh independent per-method simulator resets, original real env goals and reward only. Check 4 worlds/family per method; no selection on CHECK.
metrics.frozen_gate: Each R2 independently must reduce blocked-forward attempts per 100 actual DEV action steps by at least 30% relative to corresponding R1 in BOTH families; succeed in >=4/8 fresh DEV worlds in EACH family; improve >=2 actual goal completions summed across both families over its unchanged R1; achieve at least 75% of fit-learned-dynamics+BFS real mean reward in EACH family. Both R2 candidates must pass, conventional learned-dynamics+BFS >=6/8 each family, true 2-process original source identity and checkpoint persistence. Else NO QUALIFIED NATIVE LEARNED AFFORDANCE TRANSFER.
metrics.resource: Report actual per-method FIT update count, checkpoint bytes, full shared FIT source collection wall/CPU, native inference policy Python-side elapsed and Go bridge exclusions, process peak RSS; no unmeasured FLOPs or energy claim.
